name: prospectus_yfinance_retirement_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: PROSPECTUS_YFINANCE_RETIREMENT_20261107 — yfinance_info_snapshot has never existed on this host
(migration migrations/2026_10_10_yfinance_info_snapshot.sql in the repo, unapplied; the owner lane fails
every slot with 'unconfigured'). The prospectus reader r_yfinance is retired, not repaired: of its seven
fields, institutional % and short % of float are already published from the Finviz enrichment cache
(inputs.assemble -> blocks.ownership_flows) and the other five have no house source, so deleting it loses
no reported fact. config/prospectus.json maps the domain to covered_by ['fundamentals'] (the same Finviz
path), so the domain row grades from that coverage instead of from a store that cannot be read. The ETF
profile's fund-metadata reader stays and already degrades to a stated gap.
Hermetic: synthetic ZZ* Finviz record, no DB, no network, no provider call.
